name: arc-carousel
title: Arc Carousel
description: A showcase carousel whose cards hang on a downward arc, each one further out turned a little more. Stepping swings the whole arc round, the centre card easing up in size under a lime outline, and a card that wraps past the edge keeps travelling off-screen while it comes back in from the far side. Swipe, drag, the arrow keys or a click on a side card all step it.
docs:
Docs, props and examples: https://tween-ui.vercel.app/block/arc-carousel
The sample content loads images from images.unsplash.com. Replace them with your own before shipping.
Colors come from the Tween UI theme tokens (`tween-ink-deep`, `tween-lime`, …), which the CLI adds to your `@theme`. Pass your own `items`; seven or more keep the arc full, since three cards show on each side of the centre.
